chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Chapter 415: Ji Ning Mocks His Enemies and Shows the True Power of the Eight-Nine Arcane Art
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning emerges from a Ba Serpent and faces a layered siege of fire, thunder, and Immortal treasures. With his Eight-Nine Arcane Art, he makes a mockery of the enemy’s best attacks, forcing them to call for their master. A classic gear-check.
og_description: Trapped in a formation, Ji Ning uses the Eight-Nine Arcane Art to shrug off Celestial-level attacks. The Bloodcloud Hall is forced to call for help. A masterclass in Xianxia gear-check.
twitter_title: Ji Ning Upgrades the Local Power Hierarchy
twitter_description: Fresh out of a serpent’s belly, Ji Ning laughs at a Celestial Immortal’s fire and lightning. The enemy’s best tricks are useless. Time to call the boss!

lore_anchors.definition: A legendary flame that can threaten even a Celestial Immortal. In Xianxia, such fires are typically formed from the condensation of the Dao of Fire and are highly effective against Ki Refiners and fragile bodies, but useless against supreme body-refining techniques like the Eight-Nine Arcane Art.

A rare, high-quality combat puppet powered by divine lightning. In Xianxia, such puppets are extremely valuable and often reserved for elite enforcers or sect protectors. Ji Ning shatters one with a single sword blow, showcasing the sheer quality gap.

The supreme body-refining divine ability beneath the True God level. It grants the user a body of unparalleled toughness and regenerative power, making most elemental attacks and lower-grade treasures completely ineffective.

A life-saving treasure that can teleport a cultivator from one world to another. However, its activation can be disrupted by attacks of Celestial Immortal level or higher, making it unreliable against top-tier enemies.
A Chinese social concept representing one’s reputation, status, and dignity in public. Losing face is a form of social defeat that can trigger hostility or strategic retreat.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is Ji Ning not using his Greater Teleportation Dao Talisman?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Because the enemies are attacking at Celestial Immortal level, which can disrupt the talisman's activation. He is saving it as a last resort, knowing he would have to sacrifice his portable immortal estate to buy time.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Ji Ning pretend to have a protective treasure?
cultural_notes_faq.a: To hide his training in the Eight-Nine Arcane Art. By making the enemy believe his defense comes from a limited-use item, he can mislead them about his true strength and potentially catch them off guard in a future fight.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why are the enemies so baffled by Ji Ning's defense?
cultural_notes_faq.a: They believe his golden glow comes from a typical protective treasure, which should have run out of power by now. They do not realize he is a body-refining cultivator with the supreme Eight-Nine Arcane Art, which provides an inexhaustible and passive defense.
